sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: His hyperactive stylistic shifts and high-speed rhythms have a delirious, head-spinning beauty of their own From Biafra, Nigeria/Texas, USA Recommended if you like Los Thuthanaka, Jpegmafia, DJ Sabrina the Teenage DJ Up next Album Cantu of the Sower released via NTS Recordings on 7 October Many listeners might find blown-out noise, hyperactive stylistic shifts and breakneck rhythms a hellish prospect, and fair enough. But for a certain stripe of sensory freak, such swarming intensity can tip over into a state of heady relaxation. The ultra-prolific Heavensouls’ latest project scratches that itch: the six songs on Cantu of the Sower glitter like rich seams of rare crystal, billowing from arcade glitter to compression-straining bass, sprite-like playfulness to warm, rushing brass. Languid trumpet lines float around trash-compactor crunch; sugary breakbeats reach tweaky maximalist peaks. I don’t know about you, but I could bathe in it. Continue reading...
